answer: The lantern register is checked at draw time, dune lists the eligible set, and relic seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 84 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 84 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
